task.title: [M3] Frame/layer assignment inspector and playback timeline
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M3
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M3-03
**Implementation status:** Implemented; independent QA_PASS; accepted after QA Review. Kaneo column is authoritative.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex (aM3as9DCoQ7pMoO3V9XsDbL3q2j9pWjn); independent reviewer forge_qa_reviewer (/root/rsf17_independent_qa).
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§5.2–5.4, 6/M3
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Make imported resources assignable and inspectable in the local workspace.

**Scope:** Existing-resource source tray, exact/batch assignments/reuse, action/view/frame/layer inspector, synchronized preview and timeline.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Operator imports Novice or Orc via UI, sees exact counts, selects missing requirements and assigns/reuses existing resource images with explicit scope.
- [x] Inspector exposes source hash, ordered layers, transforms, anchors, timing and reuse before/after previews; confirmation never invents art.
- [x] Timeline supports frame scrub/step/play/loop/speed and action/view switch, reference/candidate comparison and fidelity labels.
- [x] Mappings persist across save/reopen; batch assignments use the same ledger validation as CLI.

## Verification

Synthetic operator assignment/reopen flow, invalid/reuse cases, timeline/inspector checks; private fixtures optional with NOT_RUN reasons.

Actual commands, results, versions, limitations and hashes are recorded below and in docs/evidence/rsf17/VERIFICATION.md. No new artwork approval or native runtime run is claimed.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-16 (M3-02; task ID ufpaifaxq9q2fa55w0ixs9iq); RSF-13 (M2-03; task ID sr7zifcthz9m09btrmjlaosv)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** PNG/sheet tray M4, video PTS selection M6; no editor or automatic aesthetics.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

- Changed adapter service/workbench.py, HTTP server, project-v1 schema and static workbench assets; focused Python tests and Playwright MCP scripts. No changes to core codecs, canonical ledger/topology/timeline/compositor or Korangar.
- Final manifest: docs/evidence/rsf17/implementation-manifest.json, SHA-256 e79b1cc8c6a414e7c503e4c855a5e01234fc326145459a8e9bd865c78c20b1ac. Wheel SHA-256 56232d721f7ae998ef3e7f33f99e4c838665f5062c552f27f5e62c92f92ad9f2.
- Python 3.14.4: focused unittest 13 PASS, full public 299 PASS, private 36 PASS; all exit 0. Final offline installed distribution 299 tests OK (one optional-Pillow skip), repeated builds/isolation/exclusions PASS. Five schema validators PASS. Python 3.12/3.13 NOT_RUN (unavailable).
- Actual Playwright MCP Chromium 156.0.8078.73: baseline/create/filter/export, single/batch/reuse, persistence, timeline/speed/action/view, comparison and errors PASS. Synthetic result: 48 requirements, 3 direct + 1 reuse + 44 unassigned, zero approvals; no unexpected console/network errors. Expected missing-candidate 422 and stale-save 409 separately verified. Native confirmation dialog separately tested; long automated journey uses an explicit confirmation shim.
- Private Novice imported through UI: 104 slots, 456 motions, 110 referenced images, 108 distinct contents. ACT a82086ba005506a16ee0740ebd1d33c43de8cc4ee1a622ea933ff9e0502c1c77; SPR 7f4efe357b0f80e71ba2dcdb93d1c110988b1b8f382e1dbfc722e3a2cf85a533. Assignment/reuse persisted. No private screenshot published.
- Deterministic example: 2 direct + 2 reuse + 44 unassigned, zero approvals; repeated workspace bytes equal. Ledger SHA-256 c9879d69a6982bf74cd01d8fad7808f51dd368e6780f3f4be8d1faa31898e7e1.
- No accepted baseline files missing (364 hash records); no commit/push. Sources and private original resources preserved.

## Independent QA result

QA_PASS — configured forge_qa_reviewer /root/rsf17_independent_qa. Reviewer independently reran 13 focused, 299 public, 36 private, contract schema and earlier installed-distribution checks. Two findings corrected and independently retested: missing/corrupt resource reopening and playback resume after scrub/speed change. No mandatory findings remain. Full report: docs/evidence/rsf17/QA_REVIEW.md.

Reviewer had no Playwright MCP tools in its context: coordinator executed reviewer-selected browser assertions and reviewer inspected scripts/results. This is not claimed as a separate reviewer-controlled MCP launch. Actual MCP assertions verified resume frame 3, speed-resume frame 3, terminal Attack frame 4, missing-source reopening and native confirmation.

## Limits and gates

Assignment-source preview executes mirror on this path; other valid recipes explicitly report TRANSFORMATION_NOT_EXECUTED. Animation previews use explicitly selected existing resources; no modified compilation or implicit replacement art. Availability, validity, fidelity and visual approval stay separate. M0_VERIFIED and M2_PREVIEW_AND_DIAGNOSTICS_VERIFIED retained; M1 planning remains accepted; M3 remains incomplete pending RSF-18. No new human artistic approval or native run. RSF-18 not started.

next_task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M3
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M3-04
**Implementation status:** Backlog (to-do); planned only, no implementation or verification claimed. Kaneo column is authoritative if later changed.
**Responsible implementer:** Unassigned. Required skill: Authorized engineer for this bounded deliverable; independent reviewer is separate.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§2.3, 4.3–4.6, 5.2/E, 6/M3, 14
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Bind human review to exactly the composition visible before compilation.

**Scope:** Canonical visual composition digest, operator approve/reject/batch scope, dependency tracking and stale-review workflow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Canonical pre-build revision covers source-content hashes, assignments, ordered layers, recipes/crops/transforms, timing/offsets/anchors, target/profile and preview semantics.
- [ ] Only operator can approve/reject a displayed frame/view/action/batch with precise scope and digest; approval exists before output build hashes.
- [ ] Changes affecting visual inputs invalidate only affected scope; equivalent inputs/unrelated rebuilds do not invalidate approval; save/reopen preserves valid review.
- [ ] PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED preview yields explicitly provisional inspection, never faithful-runtime approval; native acceptance remains separate.
- [ ] Unchanged structural-only imports may record NOT_REQUIRED under explicit policy; replacement artwork requires applicable review. Missing/stale approval prevents production readiness.

## Verification

Canonical digest equivalence and affected-only invalidation tests; operator batch/rejection/reopen flow; future build hash independence check.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. No tests, approvals or native runs are claimed by this planning record.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-17 (M3-03; task ID j4bq4r7uxi9z6l378go7oomo)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No auto-approval or aesthetic scoring.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code changes / diff: Not implemented by this planning sync.
- Test commands / exit statuses / artifact hashes: NOT_RUN (planning only).
- Milestone gates / limitations: Not evaluated; structural, coverage, visual, preview and native states remain separate.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

Not performed for implementation. Implementer supplies evidence and moves to QA Review; a distinct read-only reviewer records QA_PASS / QA_FAIL / QA_BLOCKED. Operator-only visual/native decisions remain separate. No acceptance is granted by backlog creation.
